phase: EasyGas merchant-issued payment receipts and invoices

requirements.requirement: Issue EasyGas invoices and make the verified EasyGas receipt the canonical download. Keep the documents and their states distinct.
requirements.scope: Web and shared mobile download contract
requirements.uiReference: Payment return, orders and wallet document libraries
requirements.dataSource: Versioned invoice snapshots and committed payment postings. Existing approved identity and EasyGas branding assets.
requirements.securityControl: Authenticated customer or authorised staff scope; pending/cross-account references are denied and document responses are private.
negativeTests: Pending and cross-customer requests cannot download a receipt.
requirements.reason: Local production-shaped build and HTTP integration generated and verified branded PDFs for invoice and receipt. Old links produced the same authorised receipt.
requirements.testResult: PASS: document downloads, legacy receipt link compatibility, ownership and brand; build and asset trace passed.
requirements.outstandingWork: Hosted deployment and installed native visual acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: Offer an EasyGas-branded receipt notice for independently verified payments.
requirements.uiReference: Verified sandbox payment and authorised customer inbox
requirements.dataSource: Committed payment posting, current verified email, configured merchant origin and mail outbox.
requirements.securityControl: Receipt email is deduplicated per posting, available only on mail-enabled non-demo/non-preview environments, and canceled if verification/address changes. No attached financial data in email.
negativeTests: Removing email verification after posting prevents a pending message from sending.
requirements.reason: Synthetic payment verification and a fake transport demonstrated one notification, cancellation and no client-demo email.
requirements.testResult: PASS: committed payment, replay, verified recipients, mock mail, no duplicate send and demo suppression.
requirements.outstandingWork: Verify an actual EasyGas sender and inbox in an authorised mail-enabled test environment.

requirements.requirement: Ensure customers do not receive Paystack’s separate automatic receipt email.
requirements.scope: Paystack merchant dashboard and hosted merchant mail
requirements.dataSource: Paystack merchant receipt recipient preference and merchant inbox validation.
requirements.securityControl: Apply merchant-only delivery after verifying the EasyGas receipt channel for the intended environment.
requirements.reason: The Paystack receipt preference is merchant-managed and no merchant dashboard change or real inbox delivery was verified in this phase.
requirements.testResult: Not executed: external merchant preference and inbox.
requirements.outstandingWork: Deploy and verify the merchant receipt path, then set Paystack receipt recipients to business only and confirm with an approved test payment.
